testCases.call: (() => { const a = []; const b = []; const logA = crearLogger(x => a.push(x), 'A:'); const logB = crearLogger(x => b.push(x), 'B:'); logA('uno'); logB('dos'); return a[0] + '|' + b[0]; })()
(() => { const out = []; const log = crearLogger(x => out.push(x), ''); log('x'); log('y'); return out.join('|'); })()
testCases.description: reutiliza la misma dependencia en varias llamadas

testCases.call: (() => { let n = 0; const log = crearLogger(() => { n += 1; }, 'P:'); log('a'); log('b'); return n; })()
